no_action.description: Give only a verbal response without moving the robot.

stand_up.description: Move from rest into a stable neutral standing pose.

rest.description: Move into the low-power resting pose.

balance.description: Adopt a stable neutral standing pose.

walk_forward.description: Walk forward for a short demonstration. Use when the user explicitly requests forward movement.

walk_backward.description: Walk backward for a short demonstration. Use only when backward movement is explicitly requested.

turn_left.description: Perform the configured leftward turning movement for a short duration.

turn_right.description: Perform the configured rightward turning movement for a short duration.

crawl_right.description: Crawl toward the right for a short duration. Use only when the user requests this movement.

wave.description: Perform a friendly greeting gesture. Suitable for greetings, farewells, and brief attention signals.

stretch.description: Perform a short stretching gesture. Suitable for an accepted or appropriate break suggestion.

nod.description: Nod the head briefly to show agreement, acknowledgement, or gentle encouragement.

cheer.description: Perform a cheerful celebration gesture when the user shares an achievement or good news.

high_five.description: Offer a high-five for congratulations, celebration, or playful encouragement.

come_here.description: Perform the come-here gesture when the user explicitly asks Kiba to beckon or call someone closer.

good_boy.description: Perform the good-boy response when the user praises or positively acknowledges Kiba.

hand_shake.description: Offer a paw-shake when the user asks to shake hands or when it naturally supports a greeting.

hands_up.description: Raise the front paws in a playful hands-up gesture. Prefer explicit or clearly playful requests.

wave_head.description: Wave or sway the head as a subtle friendly or playful gesture.

sniff.description: Perform a playful sniffing behaviour when it naturally matches the conversation or an explicit request.

angry.description: Perform a theatrical angry gesture only when the user explicitly requests the trick. Never use it in response to conflict or a negative emotion estimate.

halloween_gait.description: Perform the Halloween gait only when the user explicitly requests this playful trick.

moon_walk.description: Perform the moon-walk trick only when the user explicitly requests it.

roll.description: Perform the rolling trick only when the user explicitly requests it and the robot has sufficient space.

be_table.description: Adopt the table pose only when the user explicitly requests this trick.

guard_mode.description: Enter desk-guard operating mode only after an explicit user request. This action must be returned alone.

play_mode.description: Enter playful companion mode only after an explicit user request. This action must be returned alone.
